description.value: Opa! of Greece is a Canadian fast-casual chain specializing in Greek street food — souvlaki platters, pita wraps, gyro, and sides like tzatziki and spanakopita — serving BC and beyond since 1998. The Mission location sits in the Outlook Village strip centre on Lougheed Highway, making it a convenient stop for cyclists travelling the Fraser Valley corridor. Catering for larger groups and an online rewards app are available chainwide.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (opasouvlaki.ca) confirms Opa! of Greece is a real, active Canadian Greek QSR chain with a Mission location listed as 'Outlook Village, Mission' in the contact form store dropdown, consistent with the OSM address on Lougheed Highway. The website confirms takeout/online ordering and a menu that includes falafel, spanakopita, hummus, and salads as vegetarian options. No branch-specific phone number appears in OSM or on the website; the only phone shown (403-245-0033) is the Calgary corporate office.
concerns: No branch-specific phone number in OSM or on the website; the corporate Calgary phone (403-245-0033) is not a local contact for the Mission location.

Website does not publish a street address for the Mission branch, so the OSM address (31999 Lougheed Highway, Unit 104F) could not be directly corroborated — only the 'Outlook Village, Mission' location name appears in the contact form dropdown.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active chain fast-food restaurant with a confirmed Mission location on a major cycling corridor; useful to touring cyclists seeking a substantial meal stop.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items: falafel, falafel snack bites, spanakopita, hummus & pita, tzatziki & pita, and salads. No explicit vegan or GF claims confirmed

wow_evidence: Canadian fast-casual chain... serving BC and beyond since 1998
